question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**population**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage can be **'Dolphin boom in Odisha's Chilika lake'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**population**'.
 
• It means 'all the people who live in a particular place or all the people or animals of a particular type that live somewhere'. (विशेष स्‍थान पर रहने वाले समस्‍त व्‍यक्ति या कहीं पर रहने वाले विशेष प्रकार के समस्‍त व्‍यक्ति या जीव-जंतु)
 
 
• *Example: the local **population**...*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *The rise in the Irrawaddy dolphin **population** in Chilika can be attributed to the eviction of (2) ______ fish enclosures. After thousands of hectares of Chilika lake were made (3) ______ free, Irrawaddy dolphins found unobstructed area for movement. (4) ______, due to the COVID-19 lockdown last year, there were comparatively fewer tourist boats on Chilika lake, which made it (5) ______ for dolphins to move from one part of the lake to another. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **natives**: connected with the place where you were born or where you have always lived. (जन्‍म स्‍थान या निवास-स्‍थान से संबंधित)
 
• **inhabitants**: a person or animal that lives in a place. (किसी स्‍थान पर रहने वाला; निवासी, बाशिंदा)
 
• **clan**: a group of families who are related to each other. (परस्‍पर संबंधित परिवारों का समुदाय; गोत्र, कुल, वंश)
